import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64
L=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','7','-l','7','-scale-to','1800','-singlefile','-png','sources/tutte.pdf'],capture_output=True,check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'sources/tutte-page7.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
print('rendered primary page 161')
